oneblock.welcome.op: OneBlock is not set up yet. Click here or run /ob setup to start the setup wizard.
oneblock.protect.no_permission: This island belongs to someone else.
oneblock.protect.outside_border: Outside your island border — level up to expand!
oneblock.setup_pending: The server is not set up yet. An admin has to finish /ob setup first.
oneblock.error.not_ready: This isn't available right now (database not connected). Ask an admin to check the console.
oneblock.island.created: Your island is ready — break the block, again and again!
oneblock.island.already_have: You already have an island. Teleport with /ob home.
oneblock.island.none: You don't have an island yet. Create one with /ob create.
oneblock.island.only_owner: Only the island owner can do that.
oneblock.island.reset_confirm: This archives your current island and starts a fresh one. It stays restorable for %d days.
oneblock.island.delete_confirm: This archives your island and sends you to spawn. It stays restorable for %d days.
oneblock.island.delete_done: Island deleted. You can start again anytime with /ob create.
oneblock.confirm.expired: Nothing to confirm (or the confirmation expired).
oneblock.party.target_has_island: %s already has an island or party.
oneblock.party.full: The party is full (%d players max).
oneblock.party.invite_expired: That invite is no longer valid.
oneblock.party.joined_self: You joined %s's island! Teleport with /ob home.
oneblock.party.not_member: %s is not a member of your island.
oneblock.party.owner_cant_leave: As the owner you can't leave — use /ob reset or /ob delete.
oneblock.party.archived_member: The island you belonged to was archived.
oneblock.progress.level_up: Border level %d reached! Your island grows to %dx%d.
oneblock.event.triggered: The block trembles — an event is starting!
oneblock.cobblemon.no_catch: You can't catch Cobblemon on someone else's island.
oneblock.cobblemon.no_battle: You can't battle Cobblemon on someone else's island.
oneblock.island.stranded: Your island is gone, so you were moved to spawn. Start fresh with /ob create.
oneblock.wizard.locked_setting: This setting is locked because islands already exist — changing it would move every island.
oneblock.buff.granted: Buff %s (%s) granted for %d minutes to %s's island.
oneblock.buff.received: Your island received the buff %s (%s) for %d minutes!
oneblock.biome.no_selection: Select two corners first: /ob biome pos1 and /ob biome pos2.
oneblock.biome.outside_island: The selection has to stay inside your island border.
oneblock.biome.limit_reached: Region limit reached (%d). Remove one with /ob biome remove <number>.
oneblock.biome.applied: Biome %s applied to a %s area (%d cells).
oneblock.biome.removed: Region removed (%s). The biome stays until you overwrite it.
oneblock.ban.cannot_ban_member: %s belongs to your island — remove them from the party first.
oneblock.ban.you_were_banned: You were banned from that island (%s).
oneblock.ban.bounced: You are banned from this island.
oneblock.admin.kicked_to_hub: An admin sent you to spawn.
oneblock.admin.confirm_prompt: Really %s the island of %s (#%d)? This cannot be undone from in-game.
oneblock.admin.reset_offline: %s is offline — the new island is created on their next join.
oneblock.wizard.locked: %s is already running the setup wizard.
oneblock.wizard.not_running: No setup wizard is running. Start it with /ob setup.
oneblock.wizard.already_confirming: All questions are answered. Confirm with /ob setup confirm or cancel with /ob setup cancel.
oneblock.wizard.saved: Setup complete! Settings saved — the server is ready.
oneblock.wizard.cancelled: Setup wizard cancelled. Nothing was saved.
oneblock.question.hub_radius: Hub protection radius in blocks (full spawn protection)?
oneblock.question.max_island_size: Maximum island size at border level 8 (e.g. 1024 = 1024x1024)?
oneblock.question.trigger_event_threshol: How many OneBlock breaks until a trigger event fires?
oneblock.question.hub_allow_building: Allow admins to build in the hub?
